featured.title: 12.12: The Day
featured.subtitle: A coup d'etat that shook a nation in the winter of 1979.

movies.title: A Hard Day
movies.description: After trying to cover up a car accident that left a man dead, a crooked homicide detective is stalked by a mysterious man claiming to have witnessed the event.

movies.title: A Company Man
movies.description: A contract killer becomes disenchanted with his line of work and spares the lives of his two latest would-be-victims. But the assassination company he works for has no intentions of letting him quit.

movies.title: 20th Century Girl
movies.description: In 1999, a teen girl keeps close tabs on a boy in school on behalf of her deeply smitten best friend – then she gets swept up in a love story of her own.

movies.title: 12.12: The Day
movies.description: On December 12, 1979, in Seoul, South Korea, military officers staged a military rebellion following the assassination of President Park Chung-hee. Defense Security Commander Chun Doo-gwang leads an unauthorized insurrection to seize control of the military and government, while stubborn Capital Defense Commander Lee Tae-shin risks his life to resist the treason and defend the republic.

series.title: 365: Repeat the Year
series.description:
A story where ten people get the chance to go back in time by one year, but unexpectedly mysterious situations start to arise when their fates are changed and twisted in the process.

Ji Hyung Joo is a detective in the violent crimes division. He used to be part of the traffic police but was promoted when he arrested a wanted criminal.

It's been seven years since the change, and he's a talented individual who always knows how to relax. Though he is happy at first to have the chance to go back in time by one year and "reset" his life, he begins to search for the truth when a series of mysterious events befall on the group of people he goes back in time with. Based on the Japanese novel, "Repeat"

series.title: 28 Faces of the Moon
series.description: The drama tells the story of a man whose life takes a downward spiral after his fiance dies just days before their upcoming marriage.

series.title: 20th Century Boy and Girl
series.description: The heartwarming romantic comedy is about the friendship and love lives of three single virgins born in 1983. Their romantic lives begin when the boy they liked in their youth shows up one day. They live in Oksu-dong in rundown apartments, and the warm human drama will be about neighborly affection, and the meaning of home, family, and friendship.

series.title: 100 Days My Prince
series.description: Lee Yool falls off a cliff and nearly dies in an attempted assassination. He loses his memory, and wanders for 100 days under a new name and personality. During this period, he meets Hong Sim, head of the first detective agency in Joseon.

series.title: 18 Again
series.description: At a difficult place in his marriage and career, a 37-year-old middle-aged man on the brink of divorce gets a miraculous shot at a do-over when he is transformed back into his 18-year-old high school body.

upcoming.title: Avengers: Doomsday
upcoming.description: Beloved heroes from distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.
